validationScope: Full 6-route/3-viewport matrix on frozen HTML/CSS; only two JS files subsequently changed, both verified by targeted behavior checks. Final screenshots capture those final JS files.

items.acceptance: 1. **exec-01 — executive first impression.** Home states current title and leadership across growth, retention, design and customer value. One primary action leads to leadership evidence. Hero scope map is readable and supported; no developer/PR counts or solo-building headline.
items.observed: Current Director of Product at Persado title, growth/retention remit, direct design-team leadership and customer-value scope are visible. Primary action navigates to actual leadership evidence. Responsibility descriptions are 16px with 14px category labels, and desktop/mobile screenshots were visually inspected. Hero does not claim a VP/CPO title or feature developer/PR counts.

items.acceptance: 2. **exec-02 — evidence before independent products.** Current portfolio and three attributed, complementary enterprise results appear before the independent-product grid in DOM and visual order. Each result explains the responsibility/decision and company/timeframe; responsibilities are separate from achieved results.
items.observed: Current responsibilities and three complementary results precede independent products in DOM and visual order at all three viewports. Shared-service first-year ARR, Candidate Texting 36% YoY customer-activity growth (separate 10% SMS-volume growth), and the nine-month/three-wave 1,500-customer UI rollout are grouped under Jobvite, 2021–2025. Current remit and historical achieved results are separately labeled.

items.acceptance: 3. **exec-03 — full story, consistent across routes.** Work/About and existing three project pages use the same source-supported facts, correct anchors, current title, and product-strategy language. Independent projects explain user/problem, product decision and status without unsupported quantified results.
items.observed: All six HTML pages have consistent current positioning and bounded independent-product claims. Work/About and homepage include the owner-supplied facts: direct Persado design-team management; about ten historical MicroStrategy direct reports; Employ partner management including $600K+ Twilio spend with no invented annual period; and product–engineering collaboration without invented speed percentages. LinkedIn remains a limited detail. All local fragment links work, including work.html#persado. Independent projects name problem, decision and status without new quantified user/revenue/time-saving claims.

items.acceptance: 4. **exec-04 — retain the approved experience.** Six routes × desktop/tablet/mobile load; navigation and artifact tabs work with keyboard; no 320px horizontal overflow, missing local assets, or serious/critical accessibility violations. Reduced-motion and no-JS content remain usable. Capture before/after and report residuals.
items.observed: 18/18 route/viewport loads returned HTTP 200; zero serious/critical axe violations, browser errors or missing local assets. All six 320px probes have no overflow. All pages have one h1, no skipped levels, a top contact action and no mobile target below 44×44px. All three artifact panels load their images and respond to ArrowRight with correct selected/focus state. Final natural keyboard tests pass on all six mobile routes: Enter focuses Leadership, Tab reaches Work, Escape closes and restores the toggle. Desktop/mobile live preference tests start during the number ticker, then reach and retain exact final values with zero running animations; desktop pointer movement after reduce leaves no transform. No-JS map and first artifact remain readable.

a11y.headings: All 18 captures have one h1 and no skipped levels.
a11y.keyboard: 27 desktop and 25 mobile focus stops visible/outlined; final six-route mobile menu path passes.

residual.finding: Existing figure used as a tabpanel triggers axe aria-allowed-role on the homepage; HTML was unchanged by the final JS fixes. This does not meet the serious/critical acceptance threshold.
The existing resume PDF was intentionally unchanged. The source plan records an older team-scope figure; align that document with the owner clarification before an eventual full-profile release.

notes: No changes were pushed or deployed by this validation.
Typography and spacing heuristics are not represented as objective defects or a universal clean-design score.
